approach: Adapted two proven generators additively. Per-run explorer.html from wolfram-cloud-sync/generate_explorer.py (slot-per-section; missing partner data renders 'pending', never destroys a section). Cross-run library.html from instrument-showcase/generate_library.py (card grid + sticky filter bar driving a client-side state object + debounced search). Library reuses the explorer's load_run() as the single source of truth and emits runs-manifest.json (schema makerbench-runs-manifest-v1) for HF Space #98.
partner_schema_stance: harness_class (alice mb#87/#88), WorkflowManifest+HII (bob mb#89), DesignDossier packet (cindy mb#103) all read defensively from run.json / sibling files; none exist in-repo yet so every slot degrades gracefully. No blocking on partner branches.
real_data_today: grader verdict (levels/score/quality/notes/artifact_sha256), model/track/seed/cost/iterations from the real results/*/*.json schema.

tests.covers: alpha all-slots, beta all-pending, score=mean, manifest has 2 entries, valid+balanced HTML, all 5 filter axes, score-band buckets

fixtures.run_alpha_vented_plate: full partner stubs (packet, workflow_manifest+HII L1, .mbc cert, model.glb, video) -> verified
fixtures.run_beta_bracket: bare run.json only -> every partner slot pending

guardrails: Additive scripts + fixtures only. No grader changes. Pure stdlib. Refs #104.
validation: Both generators run against the 2 fixture run dirs -> valid HTML + runs-manifest.json with count=2.
notes: Pre-existing repo-wide test collection errors are a missing optional dep (shapely) in this worktree venv, unrelated to this lane; the run-nav suite is self-contained and green.
